content: Magic: The Gathering has already released two Universes Beyond sets based on Marvel Comics, with Marvel’s Spider-Man in 2025 and Marvel Super Heroes in 2026. The game’s designers are taking a very different approach to their third tie-in set, Darkhold Destiny, which will launch in 2027. Rather than simply making cards based on iconic characters and comic book arcs, Wizards of the Coast designers worked with Marvel to create an entirely new storyline designed with the game’s mechanics in mind. Magic ’s vice president of design Aaron Forsythe told Polygon at MagicCon Atlanta that the inspiration for the new approach came from an unlikely source.
